text: During the Gathering, Yewstar cozies up to the CougarClan leader in an attempt to get in CougarClan's good graces. They don't seem very receptive, though. (CougarClan relations unchanged.)
When she's found, Jason ignores the RiverClan patrol's invitation and runs off.
Daisymoor gives advice to Yewstar. It's not good advice, but Yewstar appreciates the effort. (low positive effect)
Terabyte mentions that Yewstar looks good today. (low positive effect)
Prancelaurel knows that Primfreckle fake-laughed at her joke. (medium negative effect)
Prancelaurel is telling jokes about Terabyte. (high negative effect)
Primfreckle spends some time sheltering with Saltknoll during a storm. (medium positive effect)
Primfreckle learns that Bitterleaf is scared of thunder, too. (low positive effect)
Brinerump offered to groom Peatcrest and, despite his grumbling, he awkwardly accepted. (medium positive effect)
When Primfreckle gets sick for a few days, Peatcrest brings her fresh-kill and bedding. (high positive effect)
Carptail calms down when he realizes Amberfur is nearby. (medium positive effect)
Carptail saw Caterpillarfoot hide something before talking to him. (low negative effect)
Saffronfoot doesn't understand why no one visits Stellarpatch to listen to his great stories. (high positive effect)

Oddmuzzle swears that Sandpaw's fangs are longer than usual. (medium negative effect)
Oddmuzzle knows that the advice Coquitostep gave him will be helpful. (high positive effect)
Hollyheart's running nose is gone.
Hollyheart learns that Bitterleaf has been using him for something. (high negative effect)
After something unsettling happens, Hollyheart and Brindletooth find comfort in one another's company. (high positive effect)
Dahliacrest takes Heavythud's side while Heavythud is in a debate. (medium positive effect)
Heavythud thinks about how Voletuft is always reliable. (medium positive effect)
Heathstripe's friend says nice things about Antlerthorn, but it just makes Heathstripe jealous. (low negative effect)
Heathstripe comes up with a plan to sneak out of camp with Verbenabloom. (medium positive effect)
Heathstripe is sick with tick fever.
Minnowlily thinks Hollyheart isn't very considerate of others. (low negative effect)
Minnowlily reveals something to Daisymoor. Apparently Daisymoor can relate! (medium positive effect)
Flutterfeather's head finally feels better.
Archbellow makes a small sacrifice that benefits Flutterfeather. (low positive effect)
Flutterfeather got lost and Garlicberry didn't look for him. (high negative effect)
Saltknoll's sprain has healed.
Saltknoll's bad leg is feeling particularly sore this moon.
Saltknoll promises to always look out for Fleadusk. (high positive effect)
Saltknoll learns that Pheasantbrush has been using him for something. (high negative effect)
Nymphshine sees Bitterleaf help a Clanmate get unstuck from some brambles. (low positive effect)
Nymphshine complains about something Dancingfleck did. (low negative effect)
Lilynoise's small cut is no longer bothering her. Lilynoise got very lucky and has managed to recover from the poison.
Brindletooth motivates Lilynoise to do something difficult. (medium positive effect)
Lilynoise was woken up early by Butterflyglide. (low negative effect)
Mallardfeather said something the other day that made Tomatofreckle nervous. (medium negative effect)
Tomatofreckle didn't get the joke Heatherfern was telling. (low negative effect)
Tomatofreckle faded more and more as the days went by, until one day, she was found dead in her nest.
Stoatshade has a weird feeling about something Frondpad said the other day. (low negative effect)
Stoatshade, Midnighthaze, and Braveheart had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Stoatshade saw Nightglow show off a skill he never knew he had. (high positive effect)
Both Ochretail and Sardinespeckle avoid one another's eye contact. (low negative effect)
Ochretail wants to be closer to Dogheather. (low positive effect)
Pigeonbloom offered to groom Algaepool and, despite his grumbling, he awkwardly accepted. (medium positive effect)
Algaepool and Cobaltstrike debated something interesting for hours yesterday. (high positive effect)
Auburnsplash couldn't imagine how boring things would be without a friend like Sardinespeckle. (high positive effect)
Auburnsplash wants to spend more time around Bitterleaf. (medium positive effect)
Lightpelt is baffled by something Currenthiss says about religion. (medium negative effect)
Lightpelt was being condescending towards Heavythud all day long. (low negative effect)
Onemuzzle vents about something trivial to Warmswirl. (low positive effect)
Warmswirl was flattered by Hailfreckle's politeness this morning. (low positive effect)
Amberfur talks about what to do tomorrow with Fringesnap. (medium positive effect)
Amberfur doesn't think that Flightsplash's intentions are all pure. (medium negative effect)
Ochretail laughs a little too long at one of Fringesnap's jokes. (low negative effect)
Elmtrail keeps avoiding eye contact with Fringesnap. (medium negative effect)
Elmtrail guides Blotchstripe to someone she is looking for. (low positive effect)
Blotchstripe decorates Wasppelt's nest with flowers to surprise her! (high positive effect)
Blotchstripe has a stomachache.

Heatherfern worries when she is told that she's pregnant — she just isn't ready. She dares any cat to force her into that stuffy old nursery and, to her delight, no cat tries to. Maybe next moon, but not now.
Pebblechase finds the way Shimmerrunner acts increasingly uncomfortable. (medium negative effect)
Pebblechase won't keep his mouth shut during the Gathering. Diablofoot, Bitebone, Bitterleaf, and Silkymunch can barely hear the leader's announcements! (negative effect)
Pebblechase catches Saffronfoot staring at another cat. (high negative effect)
Pebblechase slipped on some rocks and dislocated his leg.
Butterflyglide convinces Braveheart to help him pull a prank on a Clanmate. (medium positive effect)
Braveheart talks with Suntooth about some Clan drama. (low positive effect)
Nightglow has been looking forward to his moons of rest as an elder. He happily retires, quickly settling into the elders' den.
Nightglow overhears Mallardfeather humming a comforting tune. (low positive effect)
Nightglow and Stoatshade drink from the same puddle. (low positive effect)
Caterpillarfoot and Shinebelly agree on something the rest of the Clan finds contentious. (high positive effect)
Caterpillarfoot feels ignored by Algaepool. (low negative effect)
Caterpillarfoot was seen chasing a kittypet off of the territory. The Clan has encountered Hubert.
Mallardfeather and Shinebelly are chatting about what they're doing today. (medium positive effect)
Mallardfeather won't stand for slander about Bitebone. (high positive effect)
Pigeonbloom swaps favorite prey with Moletooth. (medium positive effect)
Pigeonbloom thinks they can tell Caterpillarfoot something important. (high positive effect)
Algaepool helps Blizzardstripe get a thorn out of his paw. (low positive effect)
Blizzardstripe and Saffronfoot defended their Clan at the Gathering together. (high positive effect)
Bitterleaf has a friendly chat with Onemuzzle that leaves them both feeling happy. (low positive effect)
Yewstar compliments one of Bitterleaf's friends. (low positive effect)
Harefeather observes Lilynoise carefully attending to any cat that needs help. (medium positive effect)
Harefeather and Auburnsplash share stories of a Clanmate they didn't realize they both miss. (medium positive effect)
Terabyte spent a long time talking with Amberfur but was disappointed by Amberfur's lack of interest. (high negative effect)
Dahliacrest snickered when Terabyte tripped. (low negative effect)

Paellapad hopes the litter will be small — she feels overwhelmed at the idea of a big litter. She doesn't believe she can efficiently perform her duties while expecting kits and decides to move into the nursery.
Paellapad had a terrible dream about Braveheart. (medium negative effect)
Paellapad has a friendly chat with Pigeonbloom that leaves them both feeling happy. (low positive effect)
Dancingscreech tells a story to Frondpad and Frondpad suggests how to make it even better. (medium positive effect)
Dancingscreech and Suntooth debate about something interesting. Though they disagree, they stay amicable. (medium positive effect)
Fluttershade's bee sting is feeling all better.
Fluttershade thinks Saffronfoot was nice to her today. (low positive effect)
Midnighthaze says something vulnerable to Gracklefur. (low positive effect)
Gracklefur sees Lightpelt put something back where it belongs. (low positive effect)
In the middle of a conversation, Peakspore and Brindletooth realize they have less in common than they thought. (medium negative effect)
Peakspore sees Gardeniaglow neglect a Clanmate. (high negative effect)
Bitebone overhears Moletooth educating Clanmates about their fallen ancestors. (high positive effect)
Fleadusk respects Bitebone's opinion despite disagreeing with it. (low positive effect)
Bitebone and Quailfur have been sickeningly lovey-dovey all day. (high positive effect)
Snookbumble follows through on a small promise made with Bouncepelt. (low positive effect)
Anteaterspot mentions that Bouncepelt looks good today. (low positive effect)
Suntooth realizes how hard it is to hold a conversation with Gardeniaglow. (medium negative effect)
Suntooth tromped into the warrior's den with muddy paws, trailing muck straight through Peakspore, Moletooth, and Diablofoot's nests. (negative effect)
Suntooth doubts Archbellow would be able to protect her if something went wrong. (medium negative effect)
The Clan can't believe the things Quailfur and Freezefoot say to one another. (high negative effect)
Quailfur and Harefeather keep talking over each other on accident. (low negative effect)
Dogheather and Hushshimmer reach for the same piece of prey and bicker over it. Hushshimmer gets it. (low negative effect)
Dogheather talks to Bouncepelt about a mutual friend they have both been worrying about. (high positive effect)
Diablofoot's running nose is gone.
Diablofoot smells something strange on Blotchstripe. (low negative effect)
Diablofoot said she'd cover for Elmtrail, but when it came time, she got Elmtrail in trouble. (medium negative effect)
Warmswirl respects Pigmentpelt's opinion despite disagreeing with it. (low positive effect)
Prancelaurel promises Pigmentpelt that everything will be okay. (medium positive effect)
Reedheart is no longer in shock.
Reedheart doesn't think that Gentleghost's smile is genuine. (high negative effect)
Saffronfoot vents about something trivial to Reedheart. (low positive effect)
Peatcrest purrs as Speckleflake starts asking to get back to his duties. Tick fever can be so touch-and-go, but Speckleflake pulled through!
Speckleflake realizes how hard it is to hold a conversation with Terabyte. (medium negative effect)
Speckleflake notices that Warmswirl overslept. (low negative effect)
Mewhoney likes to sit near Clawswirl during conversations. (low positive effect)
Mewhoney doesn't think that Algaepool has been completely honest lately. (low negative effect)
Coquitostep can't help but admire Hollyheart's pelt. (low positive effect)
Primfreckle says something very sincere and comforting to Coquitostep. (high positive effect)
Brinerump is happy to find his body pain-free: it seems his broken bone has finally healed.
Brinerump saw Caterpillarfoot show off a skill he never knew she had. (high positive effect)
Brinerump saw Dogheather show off a skill he never knew she had. (high positive effect)
Fringesnap forgot something that Dahliacrest asked him to remember. (low negative effect)
Heathstripe explained something in detail to Dahliacrest that others wouldn't explain to her. (medium positive effect)
Anteaterspot sighs in relief as the rashes fade, promising StarClan to check twice for ticks next time.
Reedheart pulled an embarrassing prank on Anteaterspot's friend. (low negative effect)
Anteaterspot doubts whether Garlicberry even likes her at all... (high negative effect)
Anteaterspot and Coquitostep are so cuddled up and cozy in their nest they almost miss the dawn patrol.
Freezefoot didn't realize Fringesnap was flirting with her. (low negative effect)
Freezefoot had a dream about Heathstripe. (low positive effect)
Gardeniaglow trusts Pigeonbloom with a very important task. (high positive effect)
Gardeniaglow has a lot of fun with Skiphare! (high positive effect)
Mossflight is no longer bruised.
Mossflight and Ospreyspeckle find a hidden part of the territory and keep it a secret together. (medium positive effect)
Brinerump compliments Mossflight's name. (low positive effect)
Hushshimmer and Carnationmunch heckled another Clan at the Gathering together. (high positive effect)
Hushshimmer and Dahliacrest are arguing about who should take the blame for something trivial. (low negative effect)
Amberfur doesn't believe Kiwifoot when she explains that a rumor about her is false. (high negative effect)
Kiwifoot's hackles raise when Dahliacrest passes by. (medium negative effect)
In the middle of a conversation, Verbenabloom and Snookbumble realize they have less in common than they thought. (medium negative effect)
Fringesnap guides Verbenabloom to someone she is looking for. (low positive effect)
Fleadusk explains what a joke means to Archbellow. (low positive effect)
Fleadusk accuses Warmswirl of stealing something. (medium negative effect)
Skulkwillow won't take Terabyte seriously. (medium negative effect)
Spittle and flecks of bone fly while Skulkwillow gobbles down prey, reminding Brindletooth, Hushshimmer, and Peakspore to seek out better mealtime companionship next time. (negative effect)
A cloud parts over Skulkwillow and Lightpelt, shining a light on them. They interpret this as a sign that they are meant for great things soon. (high positive effect)
Murkhaven prevents something from falling on Wavelight. (low positive effect)
If it were a life-or-death situation, Murkhaven thinks that Flightsplash should be saved first. (medium positive effect)
Dahliacrest kept getting distracted while helping Icyriver and nearly got her hurt. (medium negative effect)
Icyriver is impressed by some of Shinefur's advice. (medium positive effect)
Elmtrail's stomachache has left.
Carptail told Elmtrail something awful, and Elmtrail may never look at him quite the same. (high negative effect)
Elmtrail thinks that Shimmerrunner acted disrespectfully during a patrol. (medium negative effect)
Fleadusk compliments one of Brindletooth's friends. (low positive effect)
Brindletooth tromped into the warrior's den with muddy paws, trailing muck straight through Skulkwillow, Sardinespeckle, and Elmtrail's nests. (negative effect)
Brindletooth swears that Garlicberry stole something from their nest. (high negative effect)
Garlicberry tells her Clanmates that something's off about Hushshimmer. (medium negative effect)
Garlicberry is telling jokes about Heavythud. (high negative effect)
Sardinespeckle likes to sit near Nightglow during conversations. (low positive effect)
Voletuft complimented Sardinespeckle on something nobody else did. (medium positive effect)
Sardinespeckle sneaks out at night to sleep in Mewhoney's nest. (high positive effect)
Creekmoss motivated Shinefur to get out of her nest this morning. (low positive effect)
Onemuzzle learns that Shinefur told a Clanmate one of their secrets. (low negative effect)
Meadowspots forgot something that Talonlake asked her to remember. (low negative effect)
Talonlake is deeply touched hearing just how much Warmswirl remembers about him. (high positive effect)
Frondpad can't stop thinking about the way Peatcrest glared at his Clanmate. (high negative effect)

Mallowpelt's bruises have disappeared.
Ospreyspeckle motivated Mallowpelt to get out of his nest this morning. (low positive effect)
Mallowpelt admires Onemuzzle's dedication. (medium positive effect)
A Clanmate that Onemuzzle wanted to get to know better is already friends with Heathstripe. (low negative effect)
Onemuzzle said something really rude to Sardinespeckle. (low negative effect)
Voletuft and Auburnsplash often look at each other and smile knowingly about something. (low positive effect)
Voletuft had a spat with Onemuzzle over a piece of prey on the fresh-kill pile. (medium negative effect)
Voletuft gave Snakedrop a sprig of catmint they found. (high positive effect)
Flightsplash mews congratulations to Heathstripe for a job well done. (low positive effect)
Spittle and flecks of bone fly while Flightsplash gobbles down prey, reminding Midnighthaze, Diablofoot, and Creekmoss to seek out better mealtime companionship next time. (negative effect)
Flightsplash and Daisymoor had a conversation where they realized they didn't have much in common. (low negative effect)
Skiphare has recovered from his sprain.
Skiphare is letting Glowfur share his troubles with him, hoping he'll feel better afterward. (high positive effect)
Fringesnap helps Skiphare hide from a Clanmate. (low positive effect)
Hailfreckle badly misinterprets Coquitostep's words. (high negative effect)
Hailfreckle had a bad day and lashed out at Dancingfleck. (high negative effect)
Hailfreckle has tick fever.
Shimmerrunner's poor mangled tail is swollen and hot to the touch: Peatcrest searches the herb stores for those that fight infection.
Shimmerrunner chats with Meadowspots about her day. (medium positive effect)
Shinefur lets Shimmerrunner know that a Clanmate was talking badly about her. (low positive effect)
Shimmerrunner purrs for a long time at one of Mallowpelt's lame jokes. (high positive effect)
Dancingfleck has a discussion with Drizzlepelt over favorite prey, and now they both have a new appreciation for each others' tastes (medium positive effect)
Snakedrop calls to Elmtrail to catch him a fat mouse on his next hunting patrol. (medium positive effect)
Snakedrop returned to the warrior's den dripping mud everywhere and managed to ruin Butterflyglide, Coquitostep, and Gardeniaglow's nests. (negative effect)
Snakedrop is told about Skulkwillow's bravery during a recent time of struggle. (medium positive effect)
Snakedrop and Flutterfeather have decided that they may not be the right fit for each other after all. They opt to leave things on good terms and break up.
Daisymoor bickers with Hollyheart over who gets what nest material. (low negative effect)
Daisymoor asks Nymphshine about something complicated and is amazed at how quickly Nymphshine understands. (high positive effect)
Gentleghost noticed that Currenthiss wasn't in her nest last night. (low negative effect)
Gentleghost shares a suspiciously exaggerated tale with Carnationmunch, Hushshimmer, Pebblechase, and Suntooth, who seem far from convinced of its veracity. (negative effect)
Flutterfeather and Gentleghost have a misunderstanding that makes them grumpy for the rest of the day. (low negative effect)
Gentleghost goes missing in the Twolegplace for a few days and comes back wearing a belled nylon collar.
Cobaltstrike gives Antlerthorn something that he dropped. (low positive effect)
Antlerthorn is jealous that Skiphare got to go to the last Gathering. (medium negative effect)
Wasppelt can't help but admire Moletooth's pelt. (low positive effect)
Wasppelt is wowed by how bravely Snookbumble fought the other day. (high positive effect)
Voletuft keeps asking Snookbumble if she trusts them. (low negative effect)
It seems like there's an unspoken apology between Snookbumble and Cherrytail. (medium positive effect)

A HibiscusClan apprentice asked to join RiverClan after having apparently forsaken his original Clan loyalties. He stays for only a few days before sheepishly requesting to return home. The Clan has encountered Clearpaw.
Shadowfreckle is prancing around in front of Saltknoll. (low positive effect)
Meadowspots respects Shadowfreckle's opinion despite disagreeing with it. (low positive effect)
Wavelight said he'd cover for Tansywhisker, but when it came time, he got Tansywhisker in trouble. (medium negative effect)
Wavelight settles near Butterflyglide to eat his fresh-kill. (medium positive effect)
Shimmerrunner got a weird look on her face when Cherrytail approached her. (low negative effect)
Midnighthaze's laugh reminds Cherrytail of someone she misses. (low positive effect)
Piperthrift sees Dahliacrest help a Clanmate get unstuck from some brambles. (low positive effect)
Piperthrift is always happy to be around Tansywhisker. (high positive effect)
Drizzlepelt knows that the advice Flutterfeather gave her will be helpful. (high positive effect)
Drizzlepelt struggles to make sense of something trivial Shadowfreckle said. (low negative effect)
Currenthiss notices that Shimmerrunner always gets better fresh-kill to eat. (high negative effect)
Piperthrift vents about something trivial to Currenthiss. (low positive effect)
Gorgehunt feels extremely unsettled when Carptail looks at her. (high negative effect)
Gorgehunt feels safe with Wasppelt around. (high positive effect)
Tansywhisker is hiding behind a bush ready to pounce on Shimmerrunner. (medium positive effect)
Tansywhisker lets Whiskerleg bring back fresh-kill she caught on a patrol. (medium positive effect)
Silkymunch hears a nice story about Blotchstripe. (low positive effect)
Silkymunch is telling jokes about Wavelight. (high negative effect)
When Butterflyglide gets hurt, Kiwifoot is the first to ask if he's okay. (medium positive effect)
Both Butterflyglide and Glowfur avoid one another's eye contact. (low negative effect)
Moletooth's running nose is gone.
The Clan is very uncomfortable whenever Moletooth talks about Nymphshine. (high negative effect)
Moletooth is amazed at how skilled Braveocean really is. (high positive effect)
Moletooth tells Gorgehunt romantic stories of old. (high positive effect)
Glowfur saw Carptail hide something before talking to him. (low negative effect)
Coconutocean sends a Clanmate to help Glowfur with something he's struggling with. (low positive effect)
Whiskerleg swaps favorite prey with Pheasantbrush. (medium positive effect)
Whiskerleg feels like Heathbeetle has been quieter than usual. (low negative effect)
Whiskerleg missed a tick while grooming, and is now suffering the consequences. She has tick fever.
Swallowstripe and Gracklefur roll up moss balls together. (low positive effect)
Coconutocean draws a pretty symbol in the sand that Swallowstripe makes sure not to mess up. (low positive effect)
Carnationmunch thanks Gardeniaglow for covering for her during a patrol earlier. (medium positive effect)
When discussing the future, Carnationmunch and Meadowspots discuss the policies they'd implement in a Clan of their own. (high positive effect)
Midnighthaze shared a embarrassing story about Hollyheart he was asked not to share... (low negative effect)
Midnighthaze feels like Moletooth has been quieter than usual. (low negative effect)
Tansywhisker does something that makes Braveocean's day a little happier. (low positive effect)
While Braveocean gorges on her piece of fresh kill, Marshpaw, Sandpaw, Skiphare, and Gardeniaglow find that eating is suddenly less appealing. (negative effect)
Braveocean and Currenthiss gossip about drama nobody else knows. (high positive effect)
Braveocean can't stop gushing over Glowfur. (high positive effect)
Ospreyspeckle and Carptail make each other laugh. (low positive effect)
Poppybriar makes a small sacrifice that benefits Ospreyspeckle. (low positive effect)
Shiveringdusk doesn't get why Currenthiss gets more praise for doing the same thing everyone else does. (high negative effect)
Shiveringdusk, Snakedrop, and Sardinespeckle took a sunbath and had a little small talk. (positive effect)
Shiveringdusk can't remember a word for the life of him, but Gorgehunt helps him remember it. (medium positive effect)
Shiveringdusk accidentally trespasses onto BugClan's territory.
Shiveringdusk's belly has been upset all day.
Shiveringdusk was helping reinforce the camp walls when he got a thorn stuck in his paw.
Quailfur thanked Heathbeetle for bringing him food. (low positive effect)
Heathbeetle overhears Currenthiss saying something nice about her. (high positive effect)
Garlicberry follows through on a small promise made with Poppybriar. (low positive effect)
It stings. Poppybriar is going to be nursing the hurt from Shiveringdusk rejecting him for a while.
Heathbeetle kept getting distracted while helping Creekmoss and nearly got him hurt. (medium negative effect)
Creekmoss can't stop thinking about the way Piperthrift glared at his Clanmate. (high negative effect)
Fluttershade doesn't say sorry when bumping into Meadowspots. (low negative effect)
Late into the evening, Meadowspots invites Fluttershade, Lightpelt, Diablofoot, and Icyriver to stretch with her and enjoy each other's company. (positive effect)
Meadowspots talks about what to do tomorrow with Gorgehunt. (medium positive effect)
Clawswirl left a gift in Heavythud's nest for him to find. (medium positive effect)
Clawswirl's eagerness to do early morning stretches rubs off on Algaepool, Hushshimmer, Midnighthaze, and Yewstar. (positive effect)

Miteleaf can't help but admire Flutterfeather's pelt. (low positive effect)

Mallowpelt gives advice to Coconutocean. It's not good advice, but Coconutocean appreciates the effort. (low positive effect)
Coconutocean thinks that Miteleaf's tone sounds off today. (low negative effect)
Shinebelly is fascinated by one of Reedheart's stories. (medium positive effect)
Shinebelly feels like Shiveringdusk has been quieter than usual. (low negative effect)
Shinebelly was seen arguing, and borderline-fighting, with a loner. The Clan has encountered Fallout.
Howlshine thinks Moletooth looks nicer than him today. (low negative effect)
Lilynoise was complimented by another Clan during the recent Gathering, but Howlshine wasn't. (medium negative effect)
Marshpaw turns to Fringesnap in a time of need. (medium positive effect)

When Sandpaw asked Heathstripe for help, Heathstripe ignored her. (low negative effect)

Erminedaisy's hackles raise when Algaepool passes by. (medium negative effect)
Erminedaisy and Caterpillarfoot know more about each other than anyone else. (high positive effect)
When Stellarpatch needs someone to do him a favor, he never asks Terabyte first. (medium negative effect)
Fidgetmouse points out that Stellarpatch's fresh-kill has gone bad before she eats it. (medium positive effect)
Heatherfern warns Saltknoll about something on the ground so he doesn't trip. (low positive effect)
A Clanmate that Heatherfern wanted to get to know better is already friends with Stellarpatch. (low negative effect)

Fidgetmouse and Peatcrest enjoy each other's company. (high positive effect)

As Fringesnap's Clanmates comfort him during the vigil, he can't help but wonder if things will ever feel normal again without Tomatofreckle in his life.

This past moon, m_c has taken {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} place in StarClan. c_n mourns the loss of their Clanmate, and {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates will miss where {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} had been in their lives. Moments of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} life are shared in stories around the circle of mourners as those that were closest to {PRONOUN/m_c/object} take {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} final resting place.
